Spider-topic test module for CrawlSpider rules/process_links/process_request; also listed in the mypy untyped-module backlog (module "tests.test_spider_crawl"), which marks it as pending annotation work.

Spider-topic test module for SitemapSpider; listed in the mypy untyped-module backlog (module "tests.test_spider_sitemap") and contains many unannotated defs, so it is a natural target of a spider typing pass.
Exercises spider middleware output chains and spider callbacks with mostly unannotated defs; listed in the mypy untyped-module backlog (module "tests.test_spidermiddleware_output_chain").

Shared spider definitions used by the spider test modules and other test suites; listed in the mypy untyped-module backlog (module "tests.spiders") with only a couple of annotated defs, so typing spider-related tests almost certainly touches this helper module.

Base test class inherited by the spider test modules (TestSpider, TestCrawlSpider, TestSitemapSpider); listed in the mypy untyped-module backlog (module "tests.utils.bases.spider"), and its annotations propagate to every spider test subclass.

Spider-related test package covering SpiderLoader discovery/loading of spider classes. Not present in the mypy backlog, so lower confidence, but it is a spider-scoped test module a typing pass would review.
Directly tests scrapy.utils.spider helpers (iterate_spider_output, iter_spider_classes) and is unannotated at the base commit. Spider-related by subject rather than by module name; medium confidence.
Tests spider persistence state (SpiderState) behavior. Spider-related subject matter and unannotated (except one def); medium confidence for a spider typing sweep.

Tests Spider.start/start_urls handling, added for spider start-request behavior; contains unannotated inner defs and helpers. Medium confidence: it is not in the mypy backlog but is squarely spider-related and typing-adjacent.
